annotations.title: See what a WhatsApp message costs

description: Returns Meta’s list price for one delivered WhatsApp message in a country, for each category (marketing, utility, authentication, service), in one of Meta’s 16 rate-card currencies, with the day the rates took effect. These are Meta’s list prices: a business’s bill may differ, and the notes say what changes it.

country.description: The country the messages go to, as its two-letter ISO code, e.g. GB or DE.

currency.description: One of Meta’s 16 rate-card currencies, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP or INR.
